title: Automate Gemini 4 Carbon: API Setup, Limits & Pricing
summary: Automate Gemini 4 Carbon with a Google API key and one trigger. Get the setup steps, rate limits, and solutions for common issues.
body_markdown:
## Fix Gemini 4 Carbon quota errors


When you widen the trigger, the limits bite. Tier 1 allows 1,000 requests per minute, **prices double on Nov 30** , and most failures are a 429 or a mistyped model ID, so your current tier becomes twice as expensive in sixteen days.


### Documented limits by tier, checked 2026-11-15


Here are the paid Tier 1 limits as of 2026-11-15. They're 1,000 RPM, a 1,048,576-token context window, a 65,536-token output cap, and **$2.00 input and $10.00 output per 1M tokens** .


Build your batch sizes from the RPM and output cap, because a trigger that fires faster than 1,000 calls a minute will be throttled. A response needing more than 65,536 tokens will be cut off.


I didn't confirm free-tier rate numbers, so read them from your own project's limits page before you size a test run. The rest follows from the prices.


### What the tiers cost, and what changes on Nov 30


Come Nov 30, the $2 input and $10 output rate ends, because it's an introductory price.


[Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/whats-new-gemini-4-carbon) lists $2 to $4 per 1M input tokens and $10 to $20 per 1M output tokens across the change, meaning output tokens drive your bill more than input tokens.


**Any workload you budget today costs twice as much in December.**


If the job can wait, Batch/Flex's the only listed tier cheaper than today's introductory rate.


> **Any workload you budget today costs twice as much in December.


[LiteLLM](https://docs.litellm.ai/blog/gemini-4-carbon) lays out the tiers: Batch/Flex at $1 to $5, Priority at $3.6 to $18, and Standard from Dec 1 at $4 to $20 per 1M tokens, so the Standard tier establishes a $4 minimum for workloads deployed after December 1.


Against rivals,[Frontierterm](https://frontierterm.com/prices) puts input at $1.32 for DeepSeek V4 Pro, $2 for Gemini 4 Carbon, $8 for[Claude](https://claude.com/pricing) Fable 5.2 and $10 for GPT-6 Astra, meaning the vendor you choose determines whether a million tokens costs $1.32 or $10.


After Nov 30, Carbon's $4 is still under both of the last two.


### Gemini 4 Carbon API errors and fixes


On a 400, compare your payload with the docs, since it means a malformed request or an unsupported parameter.


A 403 means the key lacks access to the model or project; check the key's project and enabled API. A 404 means the model ID's wrong, so copy it exactly from Google's model page.


Slow down and retry on a 429, which means you exceeded RPM or quota. A 500 or 503's a server-side fault or overload, so retry with backoff.


A blocked response means a safety filter returned no text; check the finish reason before parsing, or your workflow will pass on an empty string.


### Gemini 4 Carbon retries, backoff and cost limits


Retry only 429, 500 and 503, and wait longer after each attempt, with some random jitter. Never retry a 400, 403 or 404, because the same request fails the same way and you pay for the attempts.


Cap the retry count, set a maximum output length on every call, and set a spend alert below your monthly budget so a looping trigger stops before the invoice does.
